title: Edit: make the holes tapped M6
prompt: Turn the two blind holes into M6 tapped holes, same depth, and mark them as threaded (hole features with a thread).

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Two M6 threaded blind holes 12 mm deep (M6 × 1)
The Ø5.0 M6 tap drill, at the same places, still drilled from the top face
The M6 tap drill equals the old Ø5 holes: the geometry is unchanged

notes: Construction: tapped reads the hole features the prompt asks for (no geometry equivalent in the report), so a correct part built otherwise fails only that test.
